_about: The check date and the gatherers' boundaries. At each monthly refresh, set "checked" to the day the calendars were re-read. The page says "Checked <checked> · updated monthly"; the past 12 months (every comparison) and the year ahead (planning only, never scored) follow from it. firstPassTo is the last day the events/ files cover; the look-ahead files (ahead/) cover the months after it.
